name: init-plan
description: Plan-document harness. In Codex, only the plan-rag skill is usable today: it retrieves source-backed plan evidence and safely updates plan/ through the Plan RAG MCP server. init-design, init-phases, and run-phase are written for Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve and update project plan documents through Plan RAG (Codex: plan-rag only).
interface.longDescription: Four skills plus a Plan RAG MCP server. In Codex, only plan-rag is usable today: it searches the indexed plan/ corpus for source-backed excerpts and safely updates the canonical documents. The other two skills are written for Claude Code and do not run in Codex: init-design writes a project's requirements, architecture, and decisions to plan/ from an intent document; init-phases turns that design into a test-and-harness phase plan; run-phase implements one phase per run through a sweep, design, write, gate, commit, review batch loop.
defaultPrompt: What does the plan say about phase 2?
Sync the plan index and report what changed.
